vacancies.title: AI Developer
vacancies.descriptionText:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

We're looking for an AI developer with strong software engineering skills, deep proficiency in AI-assisted coding tools, and hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered applications to support AI solutions across the business for both government and private-sector clients. The ideal candidate will be a skilled software developer who can rapidly build, iterate, and ship AI-powered tools and applications. They should be highly proficient with AI coding assistants (Claude, OpenAI Codex, Cursor), experienced with agentic AI frameworks and orchestration patterns, and comfortable working across the full stack. In addition, the ideal candidate will possess a degree in computer science, AI, data science, engineering, or similar domain areas, as well as previous experience in consulting.

The chosen candidate will become a member of the Digital and Data team at Jacobs, helping drive innovation in technical project work for our clients in collaboration with subject matter experts, technologists, engineers, data scientists, project managers, and more.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications and tools using Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and modern AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar)
- Build and configure MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and integrations to connect AI models with enterprise data sources, APIs, and tooling
- Develop RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and AI-assisted automation solutions for internal and client-facing projects
- Leverage AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery and maintain high code quality
- Collaborate cross-functionally with subject matter experts, data engineers, and project managers to translate business requirements into production-ready AI solutions
- Architect and implement full-stack solutions including front-end interfaces (React, HTML/CSS/JS), back-end APIs, and cloud-hosted AI services
- Evaluate, integrate, and maintain AI platforms, APIs, and toolchains as the technology landscape evolves
- Contribute to technical presentations, demos, and documentation for both internal teams and external clients
- Participate in knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring across teams and domains
- Stay current with rapidly evolving AI tools, models, and best practices; proactively bring new capabilities to the team

Here's what you'll need

- 3-5 years of experience in software development, with at least 1-2 years focused on AI/ML application development
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, AI, data science, or similar domain
- Demonstrated proficiency building applications with AI/LLM APIs and frameworks (eg. Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI API, LangChain/LangGraph, Model Context Protocol)
- Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; working knowledge of SQL
- Experience with containerization (Docker), version control (GitHub), and CI/CD pipelines
- Proven ability to use AI-assisted coding tools (Claude, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development workflows
- Ability to travel as necessary to meet project and client requirements

Nice to have

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, AI, software engineering, or similar domain
- Experience in the AEC industry
- Experience designing and building agentic AI systems, including multi-step orchestration, tool use, and human-in-the-loop patterns using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, PydanticAI, or similar
- Experience developing and deploying RESTful APIs and backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Express
- Hands-on experience building RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding models, vector stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, etc.), and retrieval optimization
- Technical proficiency with cloud platforms and data infrastructure such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Palantir Foundry, Palantir AIP, Google Cloud, Amazon Web Services, and database technologies (data lakes, vector databases, etc.)

We offer

- Rewarding employment - full-time employment with a salary that matches your qualifications
- Hybrid work model - candidates are required to work from our Kraków or Warsaw office at least two days per week. The remaining working days may be performed remotely from home
- Flexible hours - start your day anytime between 730 and 1000 AM
- Comprehensive benefits, including Lux Med medical care, psychological support, life insurance, My Benefit cafeteria system, Multisport card co-financing, and a car/bike park sharing system
- Co-financed holidays - enjoy "Wczasy pod Gruszą" for a well-deserved break
- Global projects - engage in exciting international projects
- Inclusive networks - join our diverse employee networks like Women's Network, OneWorld, PRISM, Careers Network, Green Team, SpeakUp, Collectively, and more
- Continuous learning - participate in our Graduate Development Program, Learners’ Community, and self-learning platforms

We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected, and we’re more creative. We accept people for who they are. Find out more about life at Jacobs.

As a Disability Confident employer, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the criteria for a vacancy. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team recruitmentpoland@jacobs.com

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

vacancies.descriptionText:
Exp level:

• Minimum 8 years of hands-on front-end development experience, preferably within banking or financial services.

• Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript and JavaScript. Mandatory

• Hands-on experience with GraphQL, such as Apollo Client, and REST API integration, including debugging communication between browser applications and back-end services. Mandatory

• Comfortable working with cloud-based development environments and containerized deployments.

vacancies.title: Senior Frontend ReactJS Developer
vacancies.descriptionText:
Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain features within React-based portfolio reporting applications, including saved report packages, report generation and search functionality.
- Modernize existing applications by migrating them to Vite and an enterprise design system.
- Support the migration of legacy ExtJS applications and screens to React.
- Build, integrate and troubleshoot GraphQL and REST APIs between front-end applications and back-end microservices.
- Diagnose issues such as slow or failing API queries, incorrect request payloads and front-end performance problems.
- Deploy UI builds to QA environments, manage release branches, and support regression testing and production releases.
- Work closely with back-end developers, QA teams, release management and product owners to deliver business and regulatory improvements.
- Contribute to Agile development, Test Driven Development and DevOps practices.
Your Team

You will be part of a globally distributed Portfolio Performance Reporting team responsible for applications that support portfolio returns, asset allocation, holdings and client reporting.

The team works collaboratively across front-end development, back-end engineering, data, QA, product and application support functions, with a strong focus on application quality, stability and continuous improvement.

Your Expertise

- Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Computer Science or a related discipline.
- Minimum 8 years of hands-on front-end development experience, preferably within banking or financial services.
- Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript and JavaScript. Mandatory
- Hands-on experience with GraphQL, such as Apollo Client, and REST API integration, including debugging communication between browser applications and back-end services. Mandatory
- Experience with modern front-end build tools, particularly Vite. Mandatory
- Strong understanding of Git branching, version control and release workflows. Mandatory
- Experience migrating legacy front-end applications, such as ExtJS, to React. Preferred
- Experience working with enterprise UI/design systems. Preferred
- Familiarity with data-heavy UI frameworks such as AG Grid. Preferred
- Experience troubleshooting front-end performance issues and memory leaks.
- Knowledge of wealth management, portfolio reporting, performance returns, holdings or financial reporting would be an advantage.
- Comfortable working with cloud-based development environments and containerized deployments.
- Good understanding of Agile, Test Driven Development and DevOps practices.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work with senior stakeholders and globally distributed teams.
- Collaborative approach to problem-solving and working within diverse, cross-functional teams.
Key Skills

Mandatory: React | TypeScript | JavaScript | GraphQL | REST APIs | Vite | Git | Front-End Development

Preferred: ExtJS Migration | AG Grid | Apollo Client | Enterprise Design Systems | Microservices | DevOps | Wealth Management | Portfolio Reporting

- Expert-level backend development in modern stacks (Ruby, Ruby on Rails)

- Experience hosting and operating web applications in production, including releases, observability, and incident response.

vacancies.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Java/Node.js)
vacancies.descriptionText:
Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Java/Node.js)

100% remote

KIM JESTEŚMY?

ALTEN – Światowy lider usług inżynieryjnych i IT

Grupa ALTEN, założona w 1988 roku we Francji, jest wiodącym partnerem technologicznym, obsługującym największych klientów na świecie. W 2023 roku osiągnęła przychody przekraczające 4,07 miliarda euro i zatrudnia ponad 57 000 pracowników, w tym 88% inżynierów i ekspertów IT. ALTEN Polska działa od 13 lat, wspierając innowacje, badania i rozwój oraz systemy IT swoich klientów. Posiada biura w Krakowie, Warszawie, Wrocławiu, Gdańsku i Poznaniu. Obsługuje kluczowe branże, takie jak lotnicza, kosmiczna, przemysłowa, motoryzacyjna, kolejowa, energetyczna, finansowa, telekomunikacyjna i sprzedażowa. Zakres ekspertyzy: analiza biznesowa, cyberbezpieczeństwo, sztuczna inteligencja, analiza danych i rozwiązania chmurowe, rozwój aplikacji, testowanie oprogramowania, zarządzanie projektami, oprogramowanie wbudowane, zarządzanie jakością, industrializacja, transformacja cyfrowa oraz inżynieria przemysłowa.

Więcej informacji na http://www.altenpolska.pl

Poszukiwany: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Java/Node.js)

Do globalnego zespołu produktowego poszukujemy Senior Full Stack Engineera, który będzie rozwijać nowoczesną platformę SaaS wykorzystywaną przez największe organizacje na świecie. To rola dla osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się zarówno po stronie frontendu, jak i backendu, a jednocześnie lubi pracować nad złożonymi produktami enterprise. Na co dzień będziesz tworzyć portale administracyjne, dashboardy operacyjne oraz rozwiązania wspierające zarządzanie procesami i konfiguracją platformy w środowisku chmurowym.

KLUCZOWE ZADANIA:

- Projektowanie i rozwój nowoczesnych aplikacji webowych w oparciu o React i TypeScript
- Budowa portali administracyjnych, dashboardów oraz narzędzi wspierających operacje biznesowe
- Tworzenie i rozwój usług backendowych oraz REST API
- Integracja aplikacji z systemami wewnętrznymi i zewnętrznymi
- Praca w architekturze mikroserwisowej
- Współpraca przy projektowaniu nowych funkcjonalności i decyzjach architektonicznych
- Dbanie o jakość kodu poprzez code review oraz testy jednostkowe
- Optymalizacja wydajności, bezpieczeństwa i dostępności aplikacji
- Współpraca z zespołami produktowymi i inżynieryjnymi w międzynarodowym środowisku

WYMAGANIA:

- Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w tworzeniu aplikacji Full Stack
- Praktyczne doświadczenie z React, TypeScript oraz JavaScript
- Znajomość Java (Spring Boot) lub Node.js
- Doświadczenie w tworzeniu i integracji REST API
- Dobra znajomość architektury mikroserwisowej
- Doświadczenie w pracy z bazami danych relacyjnymi (PostgreSQL, MySQL lub Oracle)
- Znajomość środowisk chmurowych: AWS, Azure lub GCP
- Doświadczenie z Dockerem oraz Kubernetes

- Rozumienie zagadnień związanych z bezpieczeństwem aplikacji oraz uwierzytelnianiem użytkowników (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, RBAC)

vacancies.title: Senior Front-end Engineer with React
Software Developer
vacancies.descriptionText:
About Drillin

Drillin is an Estonian software and AI engineering company. We build AI agents, custom platforms, mobile apps and system integrations for businesses: agents that plan a bakery's daily production, automate 20-year-old ERP systems, and turn construction drawings into structured data. Our team of 12+ engineers works with 10+ clients, and we are now building our team in Poland.

The role

You will be one of our first engineers in Poland. You will build software that real businesses run on, from the first prototype to production: web platforms, mobile apps, integrations with business systems, and AI agents. You will work closely with our team in Estonia, talk directly with clients, and help shape how Drillin grows in Poland.

What you'll do

- Build web applications and backends in TypeScript, Node.js and Python

- Integrate with third-party APIs: accounting, payments, e-commerce, IoT devices, legacy systems

- Build features with LLMs and AI agents together with our AI team

- Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) every day, and review their output with care

- Write tests, review code and keep production systems reliable

- Join client calls to understand what they actually need

What we're looking for

- 3+ years of professional software development (mid or senior)

- Strong TypeScript and Node.js, or Python; React or Vue on the frontend

- Experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL) and REST APIs

- You care about working software in production, not just code that compiles

- Fluent English; Polish is a plus for working with local clients

Nice to have

- Experience with LLM APIs, agents or AI features in production

- Mobile development (Ionic, Capacitor, React Native)

- Cloud and DevOps: GCP, AWS, Firebase, Docker

What we offer

- 15,000–22,000 PLN/month net on a B2B contract, depending on experience

- A chance to be part of the founding team in Poland

- Varied projects for real clients, from AI agents to mobile apps

- An AI-first way of working with the latest tools paid for

- Flexible hours, remote work from anywhere in Poland

How to apply

Apply via LinkedIn. A GitHub link or something you've built is more interesting to us than a cover letter.
